name: Ron Block
notes: The Union Station banjo-and-guitar chair, and "the archetype's model for a banjo player used inside a song rather than as a soloist". The section's own scope note says why this entry looks the way it does: "in this archetype the producer role is largely occupied by instrumental specialists — the players whose parts are the train beat when there is no drum kit, and who also produce records. Each entry below is written as a parameter set for the part they contribute, because that is what the engine needs." His stated contribution is restraint: "on Union Station's ballad-dominant catalogue the banjo roll is often reduced to a sparse, low-velocity arpeggio or replaced by guitar, so model a banjo-density parameter where the roll can thin to quarter-note arpeggios without leaving the idiom". That is the quietest drum block anywhere in this section — `velocityTiers` accent 76–90 against a 34–48 ghost band, `hihat.velocities.main` down to 0.4–0.6, `kick` [1,2] on beat 1 alone, `percs` at −13 dB — plus a countermelody `densityRatio` of 0.45, the thinnest in this wing, for the roll that thins to quarters. Harmony is where he is genuinely his own model rather than his band's: his own compositions "are hymn-shaped, which in harmonic terms means plagal motion (IV–I) and long-held tonic pedals rather than the bluegrass I–IV–V cycle — a genuinely distinct progression family for the engine". So I–IV–I carries top weight over I–IV–V, `harmonicRhythm` leads with two bars per chord, and `chordDurationBeats` runs [4,16] for the tonic pedals. Keys follow the same open-G banjo constraint the Fleck entry documents. The stated arrangement device is specific and is authored: "the roll enters as a texture change at the chorus, which is a specific and useful arrangement device (banjo as the lift, in place of a snare)" — song-form structures rather than the breakdown form his neighbours use. ⚠ The entry rates itself medium with "the density parameter inferred from the sourced catalogue character [LOW-CONF]", and that flag applies to every velocity and density number above. ⚠ Also INFERRED: `bpm.mode` 100 inside the stated 65–190 band (placed in the ballad mass the entry calls the catalogue's character), the −3 ms offset, `percs` contents and the melody and bassline numbers.
